summary.qualification: Relative depth comparison; angular decoding consistency only

revision_history.change: Initial comparison of one public survey to expose date-schema and geometry limitations

source.transformation: API-selected original rows; CRLF converted to LF; numeric fields unchanged
source.digest_policy: Raw bytes; Git attributes preserve retained inputs with -text and both pinned method files with text eol=lf
source.selection: First held catalog row with a complete, unique-depth public survey; the issue input API is absent from the held catalog; no numerical error was used for selection
source.rights_basis: Public federal data; source catalog identifies government public-domain collection

units.depth: feet assumed from repository convention; not stated in opened layout

criteria.basis: assumed, based on previous experience; depth units follow the existing repository feet convention
criteria.comparison_basis: Unrounded differences; first-station depth datum; angular decoding is a consistency check
criteria.geographic_coordinates: No acceptance criterion without a qualified native-projection transform

datum.horizontal_origin: First published station; no geographic transform applied

known_limits: Depth units follow the repository's feet convention; the opened layout does not state units.
Published DELTA_X and DELTA_Y are longitude and latitude differences, not linear offsets.
Geographic coordinates are retained in stations.csv but are not qualified against computed linear positions.
Inclination and azimuth comparisons test decoding of the same input, not independent measurements.
One public survey does not qualify other wells, absolute wellhead placement or plotting labels.
